ambiguities: Game keep test: required keys are game.pk, game.type, game.season, datetime.officialDate, status.codedGameState, teams.home.id, teams.away.id; a missing linescore/box/plays is NOT a reason to drop (treated as 0 runs / missing starters / no PAs). In this data no file lacked any of these.
game_id taken from game.pk (identical to top-level pk in every file). Dedup keeps the first occurrence in (season directory ascending numerically, filename sorted) order; no duplicates occurred.
Linescore inning runs: a missing side, missing 'runs' key, or null runs count as 0.
n_pitch counts every pitch element regardless of code; code membership tests are exact and case-sensitive (e.g. '*B' counts toward nothing but n_pitch).
half: only the exact string 'top' means away bats; anything else means home bats.
bf_i ordering by ab; ties (none expected) broken by original play order.
is_start is 0 when the fielding team's starter is missing.
PA season/date/avail come from int(game.season) of the PA's game; league constants of season s use all PAs/games whose game.season == s.
wOBA: only the exact events listed get num/den rules (e.g. intent_walk num = 0; sac_bunt_double_play and sac_fly keep den = 1).
tto_bf_t: (game, pitcher) pairs having >= 1 start PA in season s; BF = that pair's number of start PAs.
last_n(T, d, n) has no season restriction (only avail < d), so early-2023 rows use 2022 games for lineups and rotation candidates.
Row window 'season >= S - 1' has no upper season bound beyond avail < d.
Lineup weights use only PAs where X was the batting team in the last_n games; if the lineup were empty (total PA count 0) lineup values would be missing (never occurred).

Run-state EWMA computed recursively (num_i = r*num_{i-1} + runs_i, den_i = r*den_{i-1} + 1), mathematically identical to the stated sum; may differ from a direct sum in the last bits. rd_mu_pre is missing if T or O has no team-game with avail < d (never occurred).
phi_T uses mean and sample variance (ddof=1) of T's runs scored; lg_phi uses runs of both team-games of each game of season S-1.
rd_p_gek_pre computed as the survival function P(X >= k) = 1 - CDF(k - 1) via scipy.stats.nbinom.sf(k-1, n=1/phi, p=(1/phi)/(1/phi+mu)) (Poisson sf if phi == 0).

Rotation candidates: q is the officialDate (date) of the latest last_n(T, d, 5) game the pitcher started for T; the conflict rule compares q values from each team's own last-5 list; the kept row takes that team's T, O, d, S.

Pitcher hand: throws of p's latest PA as pitcher (any team, any season) with avail < d, ordered by (avail, game_id, ab); if no such PA, kr_opp_lineup_k_pre and kr_log5_k_pre are missing (never occurred).
kr_opp_lineup_k_pre uses O's lineup computed exactly as in section 5 at the row's date d and season S (same value as O's team-row lkp column for that hand).
log5 g = overall league k(S-1) (all PAs), not the hand-specific k_h.
tto_t windows: start PAs of p in the window with tto == t (tto 3 includes bf_i > 27); f_t counts only 9(t-1) < bf_i <= 9t; starts counts start PAs with bf_i == 1.
